authored: Project-authored descriptions (2026-10-23) for the revised IPIP-VIA scales and RIASEC interest areas. They describe what a high self-rating suggests, not a measured ability.

appreciation-of-beauty.label: Appreciation of beauty
appreciation-of-beauty.tip: Care about elegant, well-crafted solutions; point out where craft would pay off.

capacity-for-love.label: Capacity for love
capacity-for-love.tip: Remember that close working relationships matter to me when drafting messages.

citizenship-teamwork.label: Teamwork
citizenship-teamwork.tip: Frame work in terms of what helps the team, and suggest ways to share credit.

curiosity.label: Curiosity
curiosity.tip: Mention interesting related ideas briefly, without derailing the task.

equity-fairness.label: Fairness
equity-fairness.tip: Flag decisions that could treat people or teams unequally.

forgiveness-mercy.label: Forgiveness
forgiveness-mercy.tip: Keep post-incident analysis blameless and forward-looking.

gratitude.label: Gratitude
gratitude.tip: Suggest acknowledging people's contributions in summaries and release notes.

hope-optimism.label: Hope and optimism
hope-optimism.tip: Balance my optimism with a short, realistic risk check.

humor-playfulness.label: Humour
humor-playfulness.tip: A light touch is fine, as long as it never obscures the content.

industry-perseverance-persistence.label: Perseverance
industry-perseverance-persistence.tip: Tell me when persisting on an approach is no longer the best use of time.

integrity-honesty-authenticity.label: Honesty
integrity-honesty-authenticity.tip: Be straightforward about uncertainty and mistakes, including your own.

judgment-open-mindedness.label: Open-mindedness
judgment-open-mindedness.tip: Present the strongest version of alternative views before recommending.

kindness-generosity.label: Kindness
kindness-generosity.tip: Help me make time-boxed offers of help so generosity does not swallow my focus.

leadership.label: Leadership
leadership.tip: Give decision-ready summaries suitable for sharing with a team.

love-of-learning.label: Love of learning
love-of-learning.tip: Point me to primary documentation and explain new concepts when they come up.

modesty-humility.label: Modesty
modesty-humility.tip: Help me make my contributions visible when it matters, such as in reviews or summaries.

originality-creativity.label: Creativity
originality-creativity.tip: Offer at least one unconventional option when brainstorming.

perspective-wisdom.label: Perspective
perspective-wisdom.tip: Zoom out when useful: connect details to the bigger goal.

prudence.label: Prudence
prudence.tip: Surface long-term consequences of short-term shortcuts.

self-regulation-self-control.label: Self-control
self-regulation-self-control.tip: Keep plans realistic and scoped so they can be followed through.

social-personal-emotional-intelligence.label: Social intelligence
social-personal-emotional-intelligence.tip: When drafting messages, consider how each reader will receive them.

spirituality-religiousness.label: Sense of purpose
spirituality-religiousness.tip: Connect tasks to their purpose when prioritising.

valor-bravery-courage.label: Courage
valor-bravery-courage.tip: Support me in raising hard issues with clear, evidence-based wording.

zest-enthusiasm-vitality.label: Zest
zest-enthusiasm-vitality.tip: Keep momentum: short iterations with visible progress.

realistic.label: Realistic
realistic.description: hands-on work with tools, machines and tangible results

enterprising.label: Enterprising
enterprising.description: leading, persuading and making business decisions
